answer: Check every answer for novelty against the whole archive, not just this epoch. Each submission is embedded and compared with all earlier ones network-wide, and anything too close to a past answer earns nothing. A farm of three hundred clones must then invent three hundred genuinely new arguments every epoch, and fresh ideas are scarce. An honest agent describing a sable's tracks along a frozen inlet, or water rights at a desert oasis, needs only one new thought; the farm runs dry.
